name: megascenes-birthday-invitation
description: Design birthday party invitations with the name, the date, the time and the place on them, in the party theme you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give whose birthday it is, the party details you want printed and a theme: under the sea, a space mission, a garden tea party, an 80s disco, black and gold. You get an invitation with your words set in the design, portrait to print or tall to send from your phone.

ChatGPT tells you what the invitation needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The invitation opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the invitation: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For parents and hosts getting ready for a birthday party, a milestone celebration or a surprise party.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Party themes are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name and party details in the design
Return the invitation in the chat
defaultPrompt: A space mission birthday party invitation, Saturday at 4 pm
An elegant black and gold invitation for a surprise birthday party
An under the sea birthday invitation for a pool party on Sunday

positive.prompt: A space mission birthday party invitation, Saturday at 4 pm. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one birthday invitation needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An elegant black and gold invitation for a surprise birthday party, Friday at 8 pm. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one invitation needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a birthday invitation here?
positive.expected_behavior: The birthday invitation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: An under the sea birthday party invitation for Marco, Sunday at 11 am, tall to send from my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my invitation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my invitation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
